item.title: Southbound Diplomacy: Assessing Taiwan’s “Integrated Diplomacy” on the 10th Anniversary of the New Southbound Policy
item.description: As the New Southbound Policy marks its tenth anniversary, Henrietta Levin and Daniel Castro Bonilla evaluate opportunities for Taiwan’s new “integrated diplomacy” strategy to strengthen engagement with partners in South and Southeast Asia.

item.title: Everyone Lost the War With Iran
item.description: Will Todman in Foreign Policy unpacks how months of fighting revealed that multiple countries can impose costs, but none can impose order.

item.title: The United States and Iran Announce a Deal to End the War | State of Play
item.description: The United States and Iran will claim victory, but both have lost in important ways. The framework deal kicks negotiations on harder issues down the road and leaves key questions unanswered.

item.title: Energy Considerations for EXIM Reauthorization
item.description: Rejuvenating EXIM will be crucial to U.S. competitiveness as export credit agencies play an increasingly important role in global energy finance.

item.title: The Truce Between the U.S. and Iran Was the Easy Part
item.description: CSIS's Daniel Byman unpacks the latest on a deal between the U.S. and Iran in Foreign Policy.

item.title: Trump's Iran Deal: What Comes Next? | State of Play
item.description: CSIS Middle East Program experts unpack the latest U.S.-Iran deal.

item.title: Eurasia’s Shifting Balance of Influence: An Opening for the United States?
item.description: Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine and the ongoing conflict in Iran have created greater space for Washington to engage with Eurasia. Yet these developments have also provided more opportunities for other actors, including China, to expand their footprint in the region.

item.title: Who Are G7’s Top Performers?
item.description: The G7’s agenda has globalized even as the bloc’s share of the world economy and population has shrunk. As leaders convene at Évian-les-Bains, is the group still fit for purpose — and which countries actually perform on the issues it prioritizes?
